'''Anju Chadha''' (born 4 May 1955 in Ahmednagar) in is an Indian [[biochemist]]. She is a professor at [[Indian Institute of Technology Madras]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Anju Chadha|url=https://www.iitm.ac.in/info/fac/anjuc|accessdate=16 March 2014}}</ref> She works in the fields of [[biocatalysis]] and [[enzyme mechanisms]], [[enzymes]] in [[organic synthesis]], [[asymmetric synthesis]] using enzymes, [[chirotechnology]], [[green chemistry]] and [[biosensors]].<ref name="Anju Chadha"/>

==Early life==
Chadha was born in [[Ahmednagar]] in India.<ref>{{cite web|title=Science – a joyous playing field|url=http://www.ias.ac.in/womeninscience/LD_essays/67-70.pdf|accessdate=16 March 2014}}</ref>

==Education==

In [[high school]] she was named best student. While getting her bachelor's degree at Nowrosjee Wadia College, she was awarded a Maharashtra State Government Scholarship. She was also awarded a prize in chemistry from the college.<ref name="IASACIN">{{cite web|title=Anju Chadha|url=http://www.ias.ac.in/womeninscience/anju.html|accessdate=16 March 2014}}</ref> She graduated with her degree in [[chemistry]] in 1975.<ref name="IASACIN"/><ref name="Anju Chadha">{{cite web|title=Anju Chadha |url=http://www.biotech.iitm.ac.in/faculty/anjulabsite/anjuchadha.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090527071909/http://biotech.iitm.ac.in/faculty/anjulabsite/anjuchadha.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=27 May 2009 |accessdate=16 March 2014 }}</ref> She received her [[Master of Science|Masters of Science]] in 1977 from the [[University of Poona]] with an emphasis in [[chemistry]]. In 1984, she completed her [[PhD]] from the [[Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore]]. She focused on [[bio-organic chemistry]].<ref name="Anju Chadha"/>

==Work==

Chadha is a lifetime member of the Indian Society of Bio-organic Chemists, the Chemical Research Society of India, and the IISc Alumni Association, Bangalore. She is also an elected member of Madras Science Foundation.<ref>{{cite web|title=Career profile |url=http://www.biotech.iitm.ac.in/faculty/anjulabsite/career.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090531041215/http://biotech.iitm.ac.in/faculty/anjulabsite/career.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=31 May 2009 |accessdate=16 March 2014 }}</ref>

==Recognition==

*1975 – Chemistry Prize, Nowrosjee Wadia College, [[Poona, India]]<ref name="Anju Chadha"/>
*1985 – Mrs. Hanumantha Rao Medal, [[Indian Institute of Science]], Bangalore, India<ref name="Anju Chadha"/>
*1985 – Fellow, Fogarty International Center, [[National Institutes of Health]], Washington, D.C.<ref name="IASACIN"/>
*1992 – Fellow, [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]]<ref name="IASACIN"/>
*2011 – International Women's Day Award from the [[University of Madras]]<ref name="Anju Chadha"/>
